// diagnostic

E0149

A runtime `String` used where a checked text type is expected (D-TEXTHEAD-TYPE1=A)

What

A runtime `String` used where a checked text type is expected (D-TEXTHEAD-TYPE1=A)

Why

The registered sema rule applies here

Fix

Use `Type.from(text)` to construct the checked text value before using it.

Worked example

First UI snapshot mentioning E0149: tests/ui/db_typed_sql_all_sinks_plain_string.stderr.

Error [E0149]: A runtime `String` can't be used as `SQL`
  --> tests/ui/db_typed_sql_all_sinks_plain_string.jet:8:26
    |
  8 |     _rows :: scope.query(text)
    |                          ^^^^
 Why: Interpolating untrusted text into a query or page is how injection happens; only a checked literal (its `{value}` holes become bound parameters or escaped insertions) may build one
 Fix: Write `SQL{"..."}` with `{value}` holes, or use `SQL.raw("…")` if you have audited the text
